rec.name: Payment Icons Bar (PDP & Cart)
rec.status: Built — launched (shared PDP/Cart section; reorder option deferred to v1.1)

what.text: A configurable row of payment-method icons (PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Sofort, etc.) placed near the add-to-cart button on the PDP and in the cart. Merchants choose which icons appear and whether they render in grayscale or full color. Optional extras (from the code) are a background color, rounded or square corners, and a 'pay in installments' line with a Klarna or PayPal logo and custom text. The original ticket also asked for an 'We accept' heading, which is visible in the PDP screenshot.

why.text: Showing familiar payment logos at the decision point reassures buyers that their preferred, trusted payment method is accepted. This lowers perceived payment risk and checkout anxiety. Logos of known brands such as PayPal, Klarna and Visa act as trust signals. The installment line also lowers the perceived price barrier by showing that paying in installments is possible.

how.text: Build one shared Shopify section (not separate PDP and Cart copies) that renders the icons with Shopify's payment_type_svg_tag. Each icon gets a checkbox. A 'payment_style' select (grayscale/colorful) applies a CSS filter: grayscale(1) or none to the SVGs. The delivered code uses a snippet 'ed-payment-bar.liquid' (flex row, space-between, wrap) and a snippet 'ed-klarna-custom-payment.liquid' for the installment line. Settings are stored in config/settings_schema.json, and the wrapper div is rendered where the bar should appear, for example in the cart. Wrap it in a toggle ('Display Section') so it can be shown or hidden for A/B tests. The wrapper is also given a CSS class so it can be force-shown during a test. Limit to about 6 active icons for layout reasons. The final solution is one global settings block that controls both PDP and Cart, as agreed in the comments.

items: Icon checkboxes: PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Klarna Pay Later, Sofort, Bitcoin, Shopify Pay (the ticket also requested Twint, Google Pay and Amazon Pay, which are not in the delivered code)
Display section on/off toggle (for A/B tests)
Installment line: show on cart on/off, method (Klarna or PayPal), text, text color, font size 10–40px
Icon order: requested in the ticket but NOT implemented, logged as an idea for v1.1

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with access to config/settings_schema.json (global theme settings). Uses Shopify's native payment_type_svg_tag and payment_type_img_url filters, so no app is required. Theme developer needed (the ticket says 'not possible' for non-devs). The code is cart-oriented, so the PDP placement needs an extra render call. Ticket metafield flag is 'MF/N', which suggests no metafield is required.

images.caption: PDP: 'We accept' heading with a row of outlined payment icons (PayPal, Visa, Klarna, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Amex, Mastercard) centered under the quantity selector and add-to-cart button, in a monochrome/branded style.
Colorful variant: full-color payment icons (PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Sofort) spread evenly across the full width under a black add-to-cart button.
